output.brief: The rise in ratequote's 5xx rate is real but small and, on the evidence we have, ordinary. The week of 26 Oct was 0.41%, below the service's normal upper band of 0.48% (based on 26 prior weeks, mean 0.35%). Burn rate was 0.82x, well under the 2x paging threshold. The dashboard count matches the raw logs, so this is not a measurement artefact. Booking completion was flat (41.0% to 41.2%), and there were no customer complaints. The claim that v4.18 caused it is not established: the rollout comparison set new pods against old ones, so pod restarts may explain the gap. The replica host change and partner-sync month-end load are untested. I am fairly confident no emergency rollback is justified. Recommended: record the week as within normal range, do not roll back, and do not mute alerting. Keep the burn-rate page on. Check the following week's numbers, and ask partner-sync when their reconciliation ran.
